name: TrustedLocalInstanceV1
publish: LLD-01 owns canonical instance lock and binds retained socket to 127.0.0.1 OS-selected port
generate 32-byte run secret and run_id independently
DPAPI-protect run secret as purpose run_control into owner-only runtime/run-<run_id>.dpapi
obtain PID and process creation FILETIME through Windows process APIs
compose RuntimeRegistryV2 with canonical origin, PID, birth, run/protocol/data IDs and relative readiness locator only
publish runtime.json atomically only after listening security context exists; READY health still reflects actual readiness state
launcher_verify: canonicalize registry path under expected instance root; reject unsafe reparse/ACL/version/shape
require origin scheme http, host literal 127.0.0.1 and numeric port; reject username/query/fragment/alternate host
open PID with query rights and compare process creation FILETIME exactly
verify process image is the expected SOMA host/packaged executable or accepted source launcher child for this installation
DPAPI-unprotect readiness locator after owner-only ACL/purpose/run binding validation
issue direct no-proxy no-redirect GET /api/v1/runtime/health with X-SOMA-Run-Auth and <=2 second timeout
require HTTP success and exact run_id,data_instance_id,pid,birth,protocol match registry
only then activate/open browser or treat host as controllable
shutdown: POST /api/v1/runtime/shutdown with run auth, exact target run_id and bounded 10-second graceful timeout
host enters QUIESCING, rejects new mutations and delegates transaction/connection stop to LLD-01
if graceful timeout expires, re-open PID and revalidate exact creation FILETIME and image before any forced termination
never terminate merely by stale PID/port/registry
server_guards: control endpoints require constant-time run-secret validation and exact Host
shutdown is idempotent for exact run; stale run secret fails
cleanup: run-secret file and registry are removed only after proving they belong to the current/known stopped run; stale foreign registry is never blindly deleted
rules: browser sessions and run-control secret are independent
run secret never appears in URL, registry JSON, browser state, diagnostics or audit
